description: Collect Amazon customer reviews and rating summaries with no login and no proxy setup. The actor reads the product page's inline review block (~8-13 top reviews, retried across desktop and mobile because the wall is probabilistic) and, when `extendedHistory` is on, merges Amazon's public extended review feed for the same ASIN (typically 100-850+ unique US reviews). `mergeMarketplaces` adds the product page from other Amazon marketplaces and unions the deduplicated reviews.

categoryUrls.description: Advanced mode: supply your own Amazon `/s?...` or `/b?node=...` category/search URL(s) directly (used only when `productUrls` is empty). Products are discovered the same way as `keywords`.
categoryUrls.title: Category / Search URLs (auto-discover products)

country.description: Amazon country domain to scrape from. URLs from a different domain are honored automatically.
country.title: Amazon Domain

extendedHistory.description: Merge Amazon's public extended review feed for each ASIN (no login, no cookie): up to 100 reviews per star/sort bucket, and walking every bucket yields 100-850+ unique reviews for popular US products, deduplicated against the product-page sample. Coverage varies by ASIN (some products expose few or no rows) and the feed carries Amazon.com reviews only; when off, only the ~8-13 product-page top reviews are returned.
extendedHistory.title: Extended Review History

filterByStar.description: Keep only reviews with this rating. `positive` keeps 4-5 star reviews; `critical` keeps 1-2 star reviews. Applied to the merged set, so narrow filters can legitimately return few or no rows.
filterByStar.title: Filter by Star Rating

filterKeywords.description: Keep only reviews whose title or text contains at least one of these keywords (case-insensitive). Empty = no keyword filter.
filterKeywords.title: Filter by Keywords

includeAggregates.description: Emit one additional `amazon_review_aggregate` record per product with the product title, average rating, global ratings count, star histogram (plus derived per-star counts), and "Customers say" AI summary with aspects -- parsed from the same page HTML already fetched. These widgets render server-side even when individual review cards are gated, so this record is available more reliably than the reviews themselves.
includeAggregates.title: Include Review Aggregates

includeGdprSensitive.description: Include reviewer names, profile links, and avatars. Set to false for GDPR compliance.
includeGdprSensitive.title: Include GDPR Sensitive Data

includeImages.description: Extract images and videos uploaded by reviewers (full-resolution URLs).
includeImages.sectionDescription: Toggle which fields are emitted. GDPR-sensitive fields are off by default.
includeImages.title: Include Review Images

keywords.description: Search keywords used to auto-discover products when `productUrls` is empty (e.g. "wireless earbuds"). Fetches Amazon's public `/s?k=` search results page for each keyword and reviews up to `maxProductsToDiscover` resulting products.
keywords.title: Keywords (auto-discover products)

maxProductsToDiscover.description: Maximum number of products to discover per run from `keywords`/`categoryUrls`. Ignored when `productUrls` is supplied directly.
maxProductsToDiscover.title: Max Products to Discover

maxReviews.description: Hard cap on the number of reviews returned per product AFTER merging and deduplication (1-2000). The product-page sample alone yields ~8-13; the extended review feed can add 100-850+ for popular US products.
maxReviews.sectionDescription: Limit and shape the merged review set returned per product. All filters below are applied after merging and deduplication.
maxReviews.title: Max Reviews per Product

mediaReviewsOnly.description: Keep only reviews that include at least one reviewer-uploaded image or video.
mediaReviewsOnly.title: Media Reviews Only

mergeMarketplaces.description: Additional Amazon marketplaces whose product page is fetched for the same ASIN and whose reviews are merged (deduplicated by review ID and content). Each marketplace typically adds a handful of locally-written reviews. Empty = only the product's own marketplace.
mergeMarketplaces.title: Merge Extra Marketplaces

productUrls.description: List of Amazon product URLs to scrape reviews from. Supports /dp/, /gp/product/, /gp/aw/d/ and /product/ URL formats across 19+ Amazon domains. A bare 10-character ASIN (e.g. "B09X7MPX8L", no URL) is also accepted -- it is expanded into a full URL using the `country` domain below. Leave empty and use `keywords`/`categoryUrls` instead to discover products automatically.
productUrls.sectionDescription: Product URLs whose reviews should be scraped. Any of the supported Amazon country domains is accepted.
productUrls.title: Product URLs

reviewsNewerThan.description: Keep only reviews dated on or after this date (e.g. 2026-01-15 or any ISO date). Reviews whose localized date cannot be parsed are kept. Empty = no date filter.
reviewsNewerThan.title: Reviews Newer Than

sortBy.description: How to sort the returned reviews: most helpful first, or most recent first.
sortBy.title: Sort Reviews By

verifiedPurchasesOnly.description: Keep only reviews carrying Amazon's Verified Purchase badge. Applied server-side for the extended feed and client-side for product-page rows.
verifiedPurchasesOnly.title: Verified Purchases Only

title: Amazon Reviews Scraper Input
